'''White Fieljine''' was a lethal [[Poison/Legends|poison]] that only affected [[Falleen/Legends|Falleen]]. It was used to booby trap the fake [[Cryodex]] during the [[Marblewood Estate heist]].<ref name="Scoundrels">''[[Scoundrels]]''</ref>
